dedupe_keys.name: q4realbpp three dimensional packing benchmarks and instance generator

description: This collection provides synthetic three-dimensional bin-packing instances and the Q4RealBPP-DataGen Python generator. TECNALIA developed twelve benchmark cases with dimension, weight, package-affinity, relative-position and load-balance constraints. Instances were sized for experiments with quantum and hybrid solvers, with reference experiments conducted in February 2023. Their geographic coverage is synthetic, with no real warehouse location. Mendeley version 3 supplies text instances and solutions, PNG illustrations, Python code and supporting pickle files free under GPLv3. Some package counts differ between the article’s tables, and measurement units are intentionally unspecified. These limitations require checking the actual instance definitions before comparing solver results. Modellers could generate loading scenarios or benchmark packing components within logistics simulations. platform-siemens-plant-simulation is a related material-flow environment, without a verified importer. The generator is included in this collection, not counted as an independent observation source. No files were downloaded and no solver or generator was executed.
